evidence.name: Screen field: Space around the button
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space around the button" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space around the button
sections.description: Sets the inner spacing on all four sides between the bar's background and the button inside it. A little padding keeps the button from looking cramped against the edges and gives a comfortable tap target; too much wastes vertical space and shrinks the visible content. Adjust until the button sits centered with even breathing room.
